findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_business, list_actions, do_action, do, request_status, reschedule_request, read_page · Private data: find_business, list_actions, do_action, do, setup_frontlatch, read_page · Public sink: list_actions, inspect_site, do_action, do, cancel_request, reschedule_request · Destructive: inspect_site, do_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_business, list_actions, do_action, do, request_status, reschedule_request, read_page · Private data: find_business, list_actions, do_action, do, setup_frontlatch, read_page · Public sink: list_actions, inspect_site, do_action, do, cancel_request, reschedule_request · Destructive: inspect_site, do_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
